faq.heading: Common trading-platform questions
faq.subheading: Quick answers about our trading platforms, features and account management.

items.q: What types of trading platforms does HATC offer?
items.a: HATC supports the widely used MetaTrader 5 (MT5), and also provides the HATC app built for mobile devices as well as the install-free HATC web trader you can use straight from your browser.

items.q: What is the difference between MT5 and HATC's own app?
items.a: MetaTrader 5 is a world-standard professional terminal with a full feature set and automated-trading support; the HATC app and web trader focus on ease of use for quick market monitoring and account management. Choose whichever suits your habits.

items.q: Can I try the platforms with a demo account first?
items.a: We plan to offer demo accounts so you can get familiar with the platforms in a risk-free environment; availability and details will be announced separately.

items.q: Do the platforms support automated (EA) trading?
items.a: MetaTrader 5 supports Expert Advisors (EAs) and automated trading scripts, suited to those with algorithmic trading needs.

items.q: What can I trade on HATC's platforms?
items.a: Backed by our AA-category Hong Kong Gold Exchange membership, HATC offers CFDs on three precious-metals instruments — gold, silver and the RMB kilobar; for detailed trading conditions please see the trading-conditions page or contact client support.

items.q: Are my funds safe on the platform?
items.a: Client funds are held in a designated custodial trust account, strictly segregated from the company's operating funds; all business follows the Hong Kong Gold Exchange compliance rules.

items.q: Are the market quotes on the platform real-time?
items.a: The platforms provide real-time market quotes; the actual dealt price follows the platform's live quote at the time.

q1.q: How do I open a trading account with HATC?
q1.a: Opening an account is simple. Click “Open account” at the top right, fill in your basic details and upload identity and address documents as instructed; once verified, you'll receive an MT5 trading account. Our client-support team is happy to help if needed.

q2.a: We offer three precious-metals CFDs: gold (XAU/USD), silver (XAG/USD) and the RMB kilobar (RKG/CNH), all traded on the MetaTrader 5 platform.

q3.a: Loco London Gold is the common term for international spot gold trading. Priced in US dollars, it offers near-24-hour two-way trading and high liquidity, and is a widely used tool for gold allocation.

q4.q: How do I use the MT5 platform?
q4.a: HATC uses the industry-standard MetaTrader 5 platform, available on desktop, web and mobile. We provide platform tutorials and operating guidance to help you install, log in and place orders smoothly.

q5.q: How do deposits and withdrawals work?
q5.a: Client funds are held in a designated custodial trust account, strictly segregated from the company's operating funds. For the specific deposit and withdrawal methods and process, please follow the platform guidance after opening an account, or contact our client-support team for details.

q6.a: Trading hours are quoted in Hong Kong time (GMT+8): summer sessions run from Monday 06:00 to Saturday 04:45, winter sessions from Monday 07:00 to Saturday 05:45, with a one-hour daily break from Tuesday to Friday (05:00–06:00 in summer, 06:00–07:00 in winter). Actual open and close times follow the MetaTrader 5 platform's announcements.

privacy.intro: This privacy policy explains how HATC Group Limited (the Company) handles data when you browse this website, or use our trading service — the HATC mobile app and the web trading platform. The website and the trading service handle different sets of data; they are covered in sections 2 and 3 respectively.

sections.heading: What this policy covers
body: The website: our informational site, which presents company, product and market content. It carries no registration, account-opening or contact form of its own.

The trading service: the HATC mobile app (iOS and Android) and the web trading platform, which let you open an account, complete identity verification, view quotes, trade, move funds and contact customer service. Both run on the same system and handle data the same way; together they are referred to below as the trading service.

This policy does not cover third-party websites and services, including the checkout pages of third-party payment providers and the official MetaTrader 5 app. Please read their own policies before using them.

sections.heading: What we collect when you browse this website
body: This is an informational website and carries no registration, account-opening or contact form of its own, so we do not actively collect your name, contact details or identity documents here.

The "Open an account" buttons on this website take you to the registration page of the trading service. That page belongs to the trading service (the web trading platform) and uses the same registration flow and back end as the mobile app; anything you enter there is handled under section 3 and is not collected through this website.

As with any website, our servers may generate technical records while serving pages — for example IP address, browser and device information, access time and the pages viewed. These records are used to keep the site running and to protect its security.
If you choose to contact us by email, telephone or a customer-service channel, the information you provide in that exchange is used only to answer and handle your enquiry.

The newsletter field in the Gold Academy is a placeholder for a feature we have not switched on: submitting it only shows a notice in your browser and does not send or store the email address you typed. We do not receive it until the feature goes live, and we will update this policy before that happens.

sections.heading: What we collect when you use the trading service
body: To open and maintain a trading account in accordance with the law, the trading service collects more than the website does. We collect only what is necessary to provide the service and to meet our regulatory obligations.

Account and contact details: name, mobile number (including country code), email address, and country or region, province, city, district and street address. Used for registration, sign-in, verification codes, your account application and account correspondence.
Identity details: identity-document type and number, nationality, date of birth and country of birth. Used for the identity verification required by regulation.

Images and documents: photographs of the front and back of your identity document, bank-card or proof-of-deposit images, your account avatar, and any images you attach when sending feedback. These are obtained only when you choose to take or upload them; the trading service requests camera and photo permissions on your device for that purpose and does not access your camera or photos otherwise.
Financial details: bank account number, bank name, SWIFT code and cardholder name; and your trading account balance, equity, open positions, trade history and deposit and withdrawal records.
Risk-assessment data: your answers to the account-opening questionnaire and the risk-tolerance level we derive from them.
Customer-service records: the content of your conversations with our customer service and anything you provide during them.
Account identifier: your trading account number, used to identify your sign-in state and to link the records above to you.

Technical data: when the trading service communicates with our servers it sends only the platform type (iOS, Android or web). Our servers may generate technical records while serving requests — for example IP address and access time — to keep the service running and to protect its security.

Referral parameters: if you reach the web registration page through a link carrying campaign parameters, those parameters (such as source, medium and campaign name) are recorded with your account application so we can identify how you reached us. This applies to the web version only; the mobile app does not receive these parameters.

sections.heading: What the trading service does not collect
body: For the avoidance of doubt, we set out here what the trading service does not do.
It does not collect your location. It uses no location feature and never asks for location permission.
It does not read your contacts, and it does not collect health or fitness data.
It does not collect a device identifier or an advertising identifier such as the IDFA.
It contains no third-party analytics, usage-statistics, crash-reporting or advertising SDK.
It does not track you for targeted advertising, and we do not share your personal data with data brokers.
There are no in-app purchases in the trading service.

sections.heading: Cookies and on-device storage
body: This website uses one necessary cookie to remember the language version you selected (cookie name: NEXT_LOCALE). You can delete or block cookies in your browser at any time; if you block this one the site still works, but it may not remember your language preference.
The content-management back office additionally uses cookies for its interface language and login session. Those apply only to authorised Company administrators, not to ordinary visitors.
No advertising or web-analytics tracking tool is currently enabled on this website. If one is introduced, we will update this policy on this page first.

The trading service uses no cookies for tracking. To keep you signed in and to remember your preferences, some data is stored locally on your device — your sign-in credentials, your watchlist, and interface settings such as rise/fall colours and chart indicators. You can clear it by signing out or removing the app.

sections.heading: How the data is used
body: Data arising from this website is used only to provide, maintain and improve the content and functionality of the site; to remember your language preference; to protect the security of the site and its systems; and to answer enquiries you send us.

Data collected through the trading service is used to open and maintain your trading account; to carry out identity verification, customer due diligence and anti-money-laundering and anti-fraud checks as required by law; to assess your risk tolerance and offer a suitable account type; to provide quotes, trading, deposit, withdrawal and transfer services; to answer your customer-service enquiries; to protect the security of the system and of your trading; and to meet applicable legal, regulatory and supervisory requirements.
We do not use any of it for direct marketing without your consent, and we do not use it for targeted advertising.

sections.heading: Disclosure and sharing
body: We do not sell your personal data.

To the extent necessary to operate this website, data may be processed by service providers that supply hosting, networking or technical maintenance. Those providers may process it only on our instructions and only to deliver their service.

To the extent necessary to provide the trading service, your data may be processed by the following categories of service provider: hosting and cloud-storage providers, SMS and email delivery providers, payment and settlement channel providers, and trading-system technology providers. The same restriction applies — they may process it only on our instructions and only to deliver their service.
We may have to disclose data where required by law, regulation or a competent authority.

sections.heading: Retention
body: We keep data only for as long as needed for the purposes above. Cookie lifetimes depend on the cookie, and you can delete them yourself at any time.

Records relating to account opening, identity verification, trading and the movement of funds are additionally kept for the period required by applicable financial and anti-money-laundering regulation. Within that period those records must be retained even after an account is closed.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: Under the Hong Kong Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance (Cap. 486) you have the right to request access to, and correction of, the personal data we hold about you. To exercise those rights, please contact us using the details at the bottom of this page.
To protect your data, we may need to verify your identity before acting on a request.

If you want to stop using the trading service and close your account, please ask us using the contact details at the bottom of this page or through customer service inside the trading service. Where the account still holds open positions or uncleared funds, those must be closed and settled first.
Once the account is closed we delete or anonymise the personal data we no longer need, apart from the records we are required to retain as described in the previous section.

sections.heading: Minors
body: Neither this website nor the trading service is offered to anyone under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal data from minors, and we will delete it if we find that we have.

sections.heading: Third-party links and external systems
body: This website may link to an online account-opening or trading system, or to other third-party websites.
The trading service may also take you to a third-party payment provider's page to complete a deposit, or open the official MetaTrader 5 app if it is installed on your device.
We are not responsible for the content or privacy practices of those sites and apps — please read their own policies before using them.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
body: We may revise this policy from time to time. The revised version will be published on this page, and the Last updated date shown here applies.
This policy also applies to the mobile app: the Privacy Policy link inside the app points to this page, so what the app shows updates whenever this page does.

disclaimer.intro: This disclaimer applies to all content on the website of HATC Group Limited (the Company). Please read it before using this website.

sections.heading: General information only
body: The information on this website is general in nature and does not constitute investment or financial advice, an offer, a solicitation, or a recommendation to buy or sell any product. We have not taken any individual's investment objectives, financial situation or particular needs into account.
You should make your own assessment before any trading decision and seek independent professional advice where appropriate.

sections.heading: Trading risk
body: Precious-metals trading involves risk; prices can move sharply and investors may lose part or all of their principal. Financial-market instruments (including CFDs) involve leverage that can amplify both gains and losses, and they are not suitable for every investor.
Past performance is not indicative of future results. Please make sure you fully understand the risks before trading.

sections.heading: Quotes, charts and illustrative content
body: Live quotes shown on this website come from the Company's own MetaTrader 5 feed. They are indicative only, may differ from actual execution prices, and may be delayed or interrupted for technical reasons.
Figures, tables or charts marked as illustrative data exist for layout purposes only and do not represent the Company's actual trading conditions or market prices.

sections.heading: Trading conditions
body: The account types, minimum deposits, leverage, spreads, contract sizes, trading hours, minimum lot size and trading commission shown on this website are the Company's current trading conditions and may be adjusted in response to market or business circumstances. The conditions that actually apply are those shown on the trading platform and in your account documentation.
Commission-free means no dealing fee or commission is charged on trades; it does not cover overnight financing or deposit and withdrawal charges.

sections.heading: Educational content
body: The Gold Academy and the other educational content on this website is neutral educational information and does not constitute investment advice or an offer. Any method, indicator or example described is for illustration only and guarantees no outcome.

sections.heading: Funds and payments
body: The Company does not accept payments from any third party; the depositor's name must match the name on your verified trading account.

sections.heading: Third-party content and trademarks
body: Some platform screens on this website are official demonstration material from a platform vendor. The instruments and prices visible in those screens belong to the vendor's demonstration account and do not represent the products the Company offers. The Company's CFD products are gold, silver and the RMB kilobar.
MetaTrader 5 is a trademark of MetaQuotes Ltd. Intellectual property in the rest of this website belongs to the Company or its licensors.

sections.heading: Availability and accuracy
body: We work to keep this website accurate but give no express or implied warranty as to its completeness, timeliness or uninterrupted availability. We may change or remove any content at any time.

sections.heading: Scope
body: The content of this website is not directed at any person or place where local law or regulation prohibits receiving it. You are responsible for ensuring that your use of this website complies with the laws that apply to you.
